topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the final lecture of the course and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer therapies and their modes of action.

topics.label: Traditional Modalities: Surgery, Radiotherapy, and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover standard approaches to cancer treatment, detailing the roles of surgical resection and radiotherapy alongside the mechanisms, toxicities, and drug resistance associated with cytotoxic chemotherapy.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Biological and Genetic Vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain therapeutic strategies designed to exploit cancer-specific defects, including hormone receptor dependence, cell cycle checkpoint deficiencies, oncolytic virus susceptibility, and synthetic lethality in DNA repair pathways.

topics.label: Targeted Kinase Inhibitors and Mechanisms of Resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on small molecule inhibitors targeting hyperactivated oncogenic kinases and examine the biochemical mechanisms of acquired drug resistance, bypass pathways, and drug addiction.

topics.label: Therapeutic Monoclonal Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the design and clinical application of monoclonal antibodies to inhibit receptor signaling, trigger immune effector cytotoxicity, and deliver targeted cytotoxic payloads directly to tumor cells.

topics.label: T-Cell Immunotherapy and Immune Checkpoint Modulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the evidence for antitumor immune surveillance and detail modern immunotherapies, including immune checkpoint inhibitors, neoantigen recognition, bispecific T-cell engagers, and CAR T-cell therapies.

topics.label: Challenges, Progress, and Future Directions in Cancer Management
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics synthesize the overarching challenges of tumor heterogeneity and clinical trial design, review historical survival improvements, and discuss future considerations in early detection, personalized therapy, and ethical patient care.
